# reComputer RK FAQ

This page contains verified answers for the reComputer RK.

## Documentation & Usage {#documentation-and-usage}

### Can the reComputer RK3576 boot the system from an M.2 NVMe SSD? {#rk3576-nvme-boot}

**Applies to:** reComputer RK3576 series, using an M.2 NVMe SSD as the system disk

**Last verified:** 2026-11-01

Yes. The engineers confirmed that the reComputer RK3576 supports installing and booting the system from an M.2 NVMe SSD.

**Prerequisites:**

- An M.2 NVMe SSD

## Hardware & Interfaces {#hardware-and-interfaces}

### Which NPU device path does my reComputer RK use? {#npu-device-paths}

**Applies to:** reComputer RK3576 and RK3588 boards

**Last verified:** 2026-11-01

The RK3588 uses renderD129 and the RK3576 uses renderD128.

**Notes:**

- The camera node differs as well.
